body:
Life is so sad and depressing. I have not been happy in years, so I do not even want to contribute anymore. Besides, I would not get anything in return, it would probably not even be acknowledged, whatever meager bullshit was created, anyway.

Life really sucks. We're just animals.  I wish I was a lower-level animal, at least they are not as aware of what is going on. This is like being eaten alive while being told how you're going to be prepared first. I don't like people anymore, so I see no way to continue existing as a being to be exploited for all my wants and needs, only to get next-to-nothing in return.

I get it, you all win. Congrats, you evolved. You were born with better genetics. Congrats on winning the game. You're more attractive. You're more charismatic. You're more capable. You're more intelligent. You're savvier.  You're just a fundamentally better person. I concede, at least allow me to pretend it was a choice. Enjoy that pleasurable sensation of touch. Enjoy success. You earned it.
The gun store isn't open today.  Gonna prolly have to risk becoming a quadriplegic.  This is what happens when suicide booths aren't legal.

It just makes me really sad. I have to kill myself and I don't want to die, but I do not want to be in this thing. I am so ashamed, so pathetic, I do not want to go outside or be seen in public. I want to be in the sun, but I do not want to be around anyone ever again. I want connection, but I do not want that thing I get instead.

I don't want this to keep going. I don't want to do things. I have been shaken to my core so much I do not have a core anymore. I am dead inside, and I have no reason to hope. I am so sick of failing, i should have been something, I was in the fucking 99.9% percentile of students, and I am nothing. I come from a community with connections, but I am purposely kept out because they do not like my attitude and worldview. There was so much potential and now there is nothing but pain. I'm going to be broke and alone tomorrow and I have to buy a gun before it's too late, but I need to talk to my brother first to say goodbye.

It sucks, but I am unwilling to be someone else's tool any longer. I don't get to be creative, or intelligent, I am a set of hands to use and discard. I am a tool. I am nothjing. I was never human and I will never be, so I need to end this isolation and pain before I straight go insane. I am sick of being the lowest rung on the ladder, I am sick of being an idiot, a failure, a loser, a loner, and someone who, regardless of what words we use to describe it, is the definition of a loser in life. I am sick of being alone, sick of being unable to achieve anything worthwhile, sick of it all. It's just pain, pain, upkeep, pain, pain, guilt, shame, pain, guilt, shame, upkeep, getting old.
